title: Tip from Angela - Learning Before you Eat
section: 17. Boss Level Challenge 1 - The Dicee Game
summary: A focus tip: schedule the hardest study or work early in the day, before eating, since concentration tends to dip after a heavy meal.

concepts.heading: Study on an empty stomach
points: Do the most demanding or most postponed task first thing in the morning, before a meal.
Heavy, carb-rich lunches tend to make people drowsy and less able to concentrate.
A lighter lunch can help sustain clearer thinking later in the day.
Personal suggestion only: skip it if you have a medical condition such as diabetes or anything else that makes fasting unsafe.
